name: Solac
tagline: Deathcare operations, coordinated with the dignity every family expects.
positioning: The case management platform for multi-location funeral and cemetery groups — arrangements, compliance, and family communication in one record.

hero.h1: No family should feel a process falter.
hero.sub: Solac gives funeral and cemetery groups a single, calm record for every case — from first call to final disposition — so nothing about a family's care slips between locations or systems.

features.title: One record, every location
features.description: First calls, arrangements, merchandise, and disposition live in a single case that follows the family across every home in your group — no re-keying, no lost detail.

features.title: Compliance without the anxiety
features.description: State forms, cremation authorizations, and required disclosures generate from the case itself, with a timestamped trail your directors and auditors can trust.

features.title: Families kept gently informed
features.description: A private portal lets families review arrangements, sign documents, and see what happens next — reducing the after-hours calls your staff dread.

features.title: Service scheduling that holds
features.description: Coordinate visitations, chapels, clergy, and transport across locations on one calendar, with conflict checks so two services never collide.

features.title: Preneed to at-need, intact
features.description: Match preneed contracts to incoming cases automatically, so honored wishes and prepaid selections carry forward without a second search.

features.title: Numbers leadership can act on
features.description: Case volume, average revenue, and turnaround time roll up across every home, giving group operators a real view without spreadsheet nights.

testimonials.quote: Before Solac, a family that started arrangements in one city and held the service in another meant three phone calls and a re-typed contract. Now it's one case. Our directors finally trust what they see on screen.
testimonials.name: Marion Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The compliance trail alone justified the move. When the state reviewed our cremation authorizations, we produced every signature and timestamp in minutes instead of a two-day scramble across four locations.
testimonials.name: Daniel Ochoa

testimonials.quote: Families used to call after hours because they didn't know what came next. The portal quieted that. Our staff spend the evening with the family in front of them, not the phone.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For independent homes ready to leave paper files and spreadsheets behind.
For multi-location groups coordinating care and compliance across homes.
For large deathcare networks with custom integration and governance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Solac is the operating record for modern deathcare groups — keeping every family's care consistent, compliant, and quietly dependable.
